v1.3.5 Hotfix
🐛 Prepared Story Dialogue Visibility: Prepared Story nodes now synchronize "Hide dialogue box on this node" to connected players. Hidden nodes keep scene, character, and picture actions visible without exposing dialogue or narration, and visible nodes restore the dialogue UI normally.

announcement.title: 🌸 Visual Novel Maker v1.3.5
announcement.content:
Visual Novel Maker v1.3.5 fixes dialogue visibility for Prepared Story nodes.

  • The "Hide dialogue box on this node" setting now applies to connected players.
  • Hidden nodes still show scene, character, and picture actions without displaying dialogue or narration.
  • Later visible nodes restore the dialogue UI normally.
